# mujoco-mcp

A general-purpose MuJoCo physics simulation server via MCP (19 tools).

## Tools
- sim_status / load_model / start_sim / stop_sim / get_state / apply_control — sim lifecycle
- list_models / list_jobs / export_frame — depot and rendering
- agentic_sim_workflow / natural_language_control — AI orchestration
- analyze_sim_state / analyze_sim_logs / discover_model — AI analysis
- record_trajectory / list_trajectories — trajectory recording
- run_population / population_results — parameter sweeps
- train_policy — RL training (PPO/SAC)

All tools annotated with READ_ONLY / MUTATING for agent safety.
3D Viewer, Trajectory, Population, Editor, RL pages in webapp.

## Setup
```powershell
uv run python -m mujoco_mcp
.\start.ps1    # web dashboard (11046/11047)
```

## Docs
- docs/MUJOCO_VS_OTHERS.md — MuJoCo vs Gazebo/Isaac/PyBullet
- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md — subprocess model, IPC design
